title: Don’t encourage people to make contact with physical objects

statement.en: Avoid telling people to touch or tap a physical object when scanning an NFC tag.
statement.ja: NFCタグをスキャンするとき、物理的な対象に触れたりタップしたりするよう案内しない。

conditions: An iOS device only needs to be near the tag; physical contact is unnecessary.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable NFC experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるNFCの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Support both background and in-app tag reading

statement.en: Support both background and in-app tag reading.
statement.ja: バックグラウンドとアプリ内の両方のタグ読み取りに対応する。

conditions: Use background reading on supported devices for quick scans without first opening the app.
Retain an in-app scanning path for devices without background reading.
exceptions: Background reading is unavailable while a scanning sheet, Wallet, Apple Pay, or a camera is active; in Airplane Mode; or while locked after restart.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable NFC experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
